_readme: Marsad parallel (black) market rate, published once and read by both the website and the app. usdLyd is the CASH rate (physical notes) - not the cheque/sak rate, which trades at a premium. gold18Lyd is LYD per gram of 18-karat gold. 'history' drives the charts: one entry per day you record, missing days are simply absent rather than interpolated. Use tools/parse_sayl.py to turn text copied off the source page into history entries. Set usdLyd to null when you have no verified figure - both surfaces hide the section rather than show a number nobody has checked. 'note' is an optional context line; it is a single space on purpose because app 2.0.1 falls back to a built-in disclaimer when note is empty. Once 2.0.2 has rolled out everywhere this can go back to "".
